tools.name: open_property_listing
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to the page for one listing, so the user can see it. Takes the `url` returned by search_property_listings.

url.description: Site-relative path to the listing, as returned in a search result's `url` field.

tools.name: search_property_listings
tools.description: Search One Place's aggregated European real-estate listings by structured criteria (facet filters, numeric ranges, sorting, pagination). Returns matching listings with id, title, price, size and a link. Use this rather than reading the rendered page.

filters.description: Exact-match facet filters keyed by field, each an array of accepted values. Values within a key are OR-ed; keys are AND-ed. Common keys: ad_type (sell|rent), housing_type (apartment|house|land|commercial|parking), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), housing_subtypes.

ranges.description: Inclusive numeric bounds keyed by field; either bound may be null. Common keys: price (EUR), rooms.total, rooms.bedrooms, rooms.bathrooms, surfaces.livable_surface (m²), surfaces.land_surface (m²), construction_year.

text_queries.description: Semantic terms matched against listings, e.g. ["sea view"]. This does NOT parse sentences into filters — express constraints via filters and ranges instead. Supplying it orders results by semantic relevance and makes sort_by inapplicable.

sort_by.description: Comma-separated field:direction clauses, e.g. "price:asc". Ignored when text_queries is supplied.

per_page.description: Results per page (default 20, maximum 36; keep small for context).
